Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5825U
 (Processor) Number of Physical Cores: 8 Core, 16 Thread
 (Processor) Turbo Speed: Up to 4.5 GHz
 Graphics: Integrated AMD Radeon Graphics
 Operating system: Windows 11 Pro
 Memory: 16GB Soldered DDR4-3200 RAM
 Hard Drive: Up to 1TB SSD M.2 PCIe NVMe
 Display: 15.6"" FHD (1920x1080) TN 250nits Anti-glares Touchscreen Display
 Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6, 802.11ax 2x2 + BT5.2
 Ports: 1 x USB-C 3.2; 2 x USB-A 3.2; 1 x HDMI 1.4 Output; 1 x Headphone / microphone combo jack, 1 x Card reader
 Built-in Speakers: User-facing stereo speakers, 1.5W x2, optimized with Dolby Audio
 Keyboard: US English
 Built-in HD Webcam: HD 720p with Privacy Shutter
 Color: Arctic Grey
 Power Adapter (Included): 65W Round Tip (3-pin)
 Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 14.15 x 9.25 x 0.70 Inches
 Weight: Starting at 3.57 lbs
 Accessory: WOWPC recovery USB for easy troubleshooting.

items: 【Processor】The AMD Ryzen 7 5825U Processor delivers reliable performance for managing work, school, and personal tasks effortlessly. With 8 cores, 16 threads, and turbo speeds of up to 4.5 GHz, it efficiently handles even the most demanding workloads.
【RAM and Storage】Maximize your productivity with up to 16GB of DDR4 RAM for seamless multitasking and up to 2TB of storage, providing ample capacity to accommodate all your work needs.

【Touchscreen Display and Ports】The device features a 15.6" FHD (1920 x 1080) IPS touchsreen display with a 60 Hz refresh rate and offers a range of connectivity options, including one SD card reader, one USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 port, two USB 3.2 ports, HDMI, and a headphone/microphone combo jack.

【Operating System】Windows 11 Pro 64-bit offers a user-friendly interface, enhanced security features, and improved performance, making it ideal for both everyday tasks and more demanding applications.
【Accessory】Your device includes a WOWPC recovery USB, designed to enhance your troubleshooting experience with greater convenience.
